name: us8-mixed-routing
description: One repository routes distinct specs to two projects of MIXED styles (FR-041, FR-042): a company-managed project (COMP) and a team-managed project (TEAM), each discovered with its own style, hierarchy, and estimation field. The config command iterates both projects and persists a per-project resolved-id table scoped under each key (no collision, FR-044). Both ports must produce a byte-identical run summary, config.local.yml, exit code, and Jira API call sequence (NFR-1).
